notes.145: Source marked B (protected material detection) and claimed it prevents customer data leakage. Protected material only detects copyrighted text and code (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/content-safety/concepts/protected-material). Prompt Shields detects document attacks, meaning hidden instructions in third-party content (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/content-safety/concepts/jailbreak-detection), which maps to the case requirement about malicious instructions in product-sheet images. No PII option is offered, so A is the only option that satisfies a stated security requirement.
notes.159: Source marked A (Azure OpenAI). Microsoft documents Azure OpenAI chat output as nondeterministic by default: 'Determinism isn't guaranteed with reproducible output' (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-foundry/openai/how-to/reproducible-output). Custom question answering (Azure Language) builds a knowledge base from FAQs, manuals and documents and returns the same stored answer each time (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/language-service/question-answering/overview). This matches the established AI-102 key for the same question.
